title: cone
body:
## cone

Creates a native Part::Cone: a solid of revolution with radius1 at the base circle (centred at origin) and radius2 at the top circle, height along axis. radius2 = 0 gives a pointed cone; otherwise it is a frustum. Choose it for countersink tools, nozzles and tapers between two circles; use loft for transitions between non-circular sections.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- radius1 must be greater than 0, so the apex can only be at the top; to point the cone the other way, reverse axis and move origin.
- Equal radii make FreeCAD 1.1 build a cylinder instead of a cone.
- Covered by the analytic-volume acceptance fixture (cone along +X, verification/2026-09-19-adaptor-expansion.json); not exhaustively qualified.

Native binding: `Part::Cone`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `radius1` | Radius of the base circle at origin, in millimetres (FreeCAD Radius1). It must be greater than 0, so a pointed apex can only be at the top. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `10` |
| `radius2` | Radius of the top circle, at height along axis from origin, in millimetres (FreeCAD Radius2). 0 gives a pointed cone; a value larger than radius1 makes the cone widen away from its base. If it equals radius1, FreeCAD 1.1 builds a cylinder instead. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":100000}` | `5` |
| `height` | Distance from the base circle to the top circle along axis, in millimetres. With the radii it sets the taper angle. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `20` |
| `origin` | World coordinates [x, y, z] of the centre of the base (radius1) circle. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` |
| `axis` | World direction from the base circle towards the top circle; the native placement turns the cone's local Z axis to it. Magnitude is ignored. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,1]` |
